reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent; actually viewed the full exact source, complete unchanged raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet and naiwa reference, inspected native-resolution raw detail regions, and verified the recorded evidence, source PNG, output, task, prompt, request, result and sheet SHA-256 values plus image metadata with read-only Python.

entries.positive_observation: The nearly frontal, slightly viewer-left pose and gaze and mild single closed-mouth smile are retained on a compact yellow mascot with green-ringed solid black eyes and no human skin, nose or ears. The bald crown, high bare forehead, short dark-brown side/back hair, short sideburns, dark brows, round dark-rimmed glasses and clean-shaven face remain source-consistent. The dark charcoal suit, white pointed shirt collar and dark tie preserve the source crop, with no decorations added. The short broad neck meets the collar naturally without pinching, floating cloth, clipping or a cream bib. The complete dark frame and opaque blue-gray backing remain. The note retains two compact upper mark rows and original blank areas without the prior two added lower dashes; the small dark right-edge tab is restored rather than replaced by a fold or notch.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette under visible-alpha-v1. Full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha inspection shows no visible interior holes, missing backing, clothing transparency or working-matte halo. Actual returned extrema [0, 254] are retained, and internal 252-254 values were not treated as defects. No source-alpha replacement was performed or is required.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine glasses-rim detail and note glyphs are too small to read at source scale, and no tie pattern is discernible. These limitations were not used to invent details or reject the image; the visible hairstyle, glasses, expression, pose, clothing, note rows, tab, frame and backing were directly compared.
